(Currently Amended) A method for preventing or treating glaucoma wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered in a manner effective to reduce intraocular pressure in a subject at risk of developing glaucoma.

(Currently Amended) A method for preventing or treating ocular hypertension wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered in a manner effective to reduce intraocular pressure in a subject at risk of developing ocular hypertension.
